hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) case "$f" in *"/.venv/"*|*"\\.venv\\"*) ;; *) uv run python -m ruff format "$f" 2>/dev/null; uv run python -m ruff check --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null;; esac;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | tr -d '\r' | { read -r f; b=$(basename -- "$f" 2>/dev/null); venv=0; case "$f" in *"/.venv/"*|*"\\.venv\\"*) venv=1;; esac; if [ "$b" = ".env" ] || [ "$b" = "uv.lock" ] || [ "$venv" = "1" ]; then jq -n --arg reason "Blocked: $f is a protected secrets/lockfile/venv path per SECURITY.md. Use environment variables or run uv sync/uv lock instead." '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":$reason}}'; fi; } 2>/dev/null
